title: After a ship that ran the review, the close report's native_step says ran null while its why says the review ran
symptom: relayed_decision.native_step is {ran: null, why: 'ran specsync change review <id> as <actor> with verdict pass'}
trigger: chough change ship <id> --close-gate <review gate> with the relay, with no current scoped review
expected: native_step names the step that ran, as a close that runs it does
actual: The close reports only why, with ran null
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester build at 9c30b881, debug, real SpecSync 6.3.0
impact: A reader of the output sees a contradiction; the recorded relay is right

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: A3-1 fixed the recorded relay (native and actor on the Timeline); this is the command's printed close report, whose native_step still says ran null
status: open -> investigating. Red at f9c268fd (before its fix): native_step said ran null; fix in 935422b8.
status: investigating -> verified. Green at 935422b8: TC-cli-a-ship-reports-the-review-it-ran passed; clippy --all-targets clean; change, relay and humans tests pass.
